tier1.headline: Your Data Trains AI
tier1.quote: Some project websites are using Kapa.AI to provide an advanced interface to their documentation. Some project websites are using Algolia to provide an AI Search of their documentation.

tier1.headline: Your Data Is Collected
tier1.quote: When you visit our websites ( full list of domains ) or one of our subdomains, the browser on your device automatically sends information to the server of our website.

tier2.headline: Your Data Travels Globally
tier2.quote: The Apache Software Foundation uses the Amazon Web Services (“AWS”) service of Amazon Web Services, Inc. (P.O. Box 81226, Seattle, WA 98108-1226, USA), to host DNS records. By the nature of DNS, the data is stored in several servers around the globe.

tier2.headline: Your Location Is Collected
tier2.quote: Geo information of the location from which access is made

tier2.headline: Your Data Disclosed Legally
tier2.quote: Disclosure pursuant to Art. 6 para. 1 sentence 1 lit. c GDPR is a legal obligation.

tier2.headline: Your Deletion Rights Limited
tier2.quote: to demand the deletion of your personal data stored by us, unless the processing is required for the exercise of the right to freedom of expression and information, for the fulfillment of a legal obligation, for reasons of public interest or for the assertion, exercise or defense of Legal claims.
